decision.summary: The Federal Reserve decided to keep the target range for the federal funds rate at 5-1/4 to 5-1/2 percent.

changes.quote: Recent indicators suggest that economic activity has been expanding at a solid pace.
changes.explanation: The statement updates language regarding economic growth from slowing from a strong third-quarter pace to expanding at a solid pace.

changes.quote: The Committee judges that the risks to achieving its employment and inflation goals are moving into better balance.
changes.explanation: The Fed added this new language to signal that risks to its dual mandate of jobs and inflation are evening out.

changes.quote: The Committee does not expect it will be appropriate to reduce the target range until it has gained greater confidence that inflation is moving sustainably toward 2 percent.
changes.explanation: This new addition pushes back against expectations of an immediate rate cut by stating they need more confidence on inflation first.

tone_quotes.quote: The Committee judges that the risks to achieving its employment and inflation goals are moving into better balance.
The Committee does not expect it will be appropriate to reduce the target range until it has gained greater confidence that inflation is moving sustainably toward 2 percent.

for_you.text: Card rates should not move on this decision; a $5,000 balance at about 21.19% APR costs about $88.29 a month in interest.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury yield, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 3.99% and moved -7 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 6.6% would fall by about $13.85 a month.
Savings yields should stay roughly where they are, since the Fed held rates.
Unemployment was 3.8%, and employers added an average of 147k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 3.3% over the past year (December 2023); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 3.2%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a 3.6% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved -9 bp on the day, and the S&P 500 moved -1.61%.
The broad trade-weighted dollar moved -0.14% on the day.

whats_next: The statement signals that upcoming meetings will depend on incoming data and the evolving balance of risks before any rate cuts are considered. An educational forecast model gave the next meeting as hold 66%, cut 34%, and hike 0%.

citations.detail: In support of its goals, the Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 5-1/4 to 5-1/2 percent.
